description: Office of the District Secretary - Gampaha - Annual Feast of St. Sebastian's National Shrine - Kadana 2026
categorisation: The gazette content announces the dates and regulations for the Annual Feast of St. Sebastian's National Shrine. This is an administrative notice regarding a religious/cultural event and references the Pilgrimage Ordinance. It does not involve government structure/personnel (Types 1-3) nor does it fit any of the specialized categories (Land, Legal, Commercial, Elections, Public Service, or Judicial). Therefore, it falls under Miscellaneous administrative matters.
